notes.title: Everything is Peachy!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re Peacock Dreams games, a team of 4 that got together for the Moray Game Jam, where we made the prototype in 48 hours. We ended up winning and taking the prototype further, developing it over six weeks in a placement with Hunted Cow Studios and I’m extremely happy to present our first game, Everything is Peachy, available now! 

If you have any questions, queries or issues please don’t hesitate to contact us through the forum (bugs thread for issues), or via our website www.peachygame.com.

We hope to update the game further in the future by adding more content and developing the existing mechanics. Thank you for reading and we hope you enjoy the game! 

Peacock Dreams Games
